info.title: SIDE ROOM API
info.description: Discord-shaped REST API. `/api/v10` is an alias of `/api/v1`.

get.summary:
The Activities a member can start: released ones with a reviewed bundle, and the development builds
they own or test.
A running Activity and who is in it.

delete.summary: End an Activity for everybody (its starter, or Manage Channels).

post.summary: Join a running Activity.
Leave an Activity; the last one out ends it.

get.summary: Page through the staff access log, newest first (`VIEW_ACCESS_LOG`).
Verify the whole hash chain (`VIEW_ACCESS_LOG`). A break raises a staff alert.
Search accounts (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`), paginated by id.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Username, display name, email fragment or exact id

parameters.name: discord_id
parameters.description: Accounts linked to this Discord user id

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: Accounts that signed in from this IP address

get.summary: Account drawer (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`). The read is logged.

post.summary: Grant and revoke public badges (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).
Platform-ban the Person behind an account (`PLATFORM_BAN`).

Replace an account's email; it becomes unverified and links sent to the old address
stop working (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`). Needs a fresh second factor.

get.summary: Credit balance and ledger (newest first).

post.summary: Grant or revoke invite credits with a reason.
Record an account deletion request (stub: nothing is deleted) (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).

get.summary:
The original username, email and display name of a deleted account, from the staff-only archive
(`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`, D-326). Each view is written to the access log.

post.summary: Revoke every session of an account (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).

Make the password unusable and end every session; the account's owner must use
"Forgot password" to get back in (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`). Needs a fresh second factor.

Freeze the account's invite creation by hand (`MANAGE_INVITES`, reason required). The member
sees the generic "invites are unavailable" wording.

get.summary: Servers an account belongs to (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).
Accounts invited, directly or not, up to `depth` hops (at most 500 nodes).
Inviter chain (root first) and stats of an account. The read is logged.

post.summary: Change the username and/or display name (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).

Remove TOTP, recovery codes and passkeys and end all sessions (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).
Needs a second factor checked within the last 15 minutes.

get.summary:
Open sessions of an account: IP, browser and times, never the token (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).
The read is logged.

post.summary: Suspend (deactivate) an account; its sessions end (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).

Lift the manual invite freeze (`MANAGE_INVITES`, reason required). An automatic suspicion
freeze stays until the suspicion is cleared.

Split an account off into a Person of its own (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`, reason required). 409
when it is the only account of its Person or the Person is banned.
Reactivate a suspended account if the account cap allows (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).

get.summary: Recent staff alerts, newest first (`STAFF_BASIC`).

post.summary: Acknowledge an alert (`STAFF_BASIC`).

get.summary: Announcements, newest first (`MANAGE_FEATURES`).

post.summary:
Publish an announcement: a banner every signed-in user sees, and with `send_dm` also a
DM from the SIDE ROOM system user to every active account (`MANAGE_FEATURES`). Needs a
fresh second factor because it reaches everyone.

delete.summary: End an announcement early (`MANAGE_FEATURES`).

patch.summary:
Edit an announcement that is still showing: its title, message or end time (`MANAGE_FEATURES`,
fresh second factor). Severity, `critical` and `send_dm` cannot change and no DM is sent again.
409 once the announcement has ended. Every session hears `SR_ANNOUNCEMENT_UPDATE`.

get.summary: List platform bans, newest first (`PLATFORM_BAN`).

post.summary:
Press a button on a Staff Server card (`#alerts`, `#review-queue`, ...). The message must
be a system-user card in a channel of the Staff Server that the caller can see; the
action runs with the caller's own platform permissions (the card grants nothing).

get.summary: Uploaded videos, newest first (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

parameters.name: title_id
parameters.description: Only assets uploaded for this title.

post.summary:
Reserve an upload slot for an original and get the presigned multipart `PUT` URLs
(`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).
post.description:
Send each part of the file (`part_size` bytes, the last one shorter) to its URL with `PUT`
and keep the `ETag` response header of every part, then call the `complete` endpoint with the
parts. A slot that is never completed expires after a day. Files over the configured size
limit (`cinema.upload.max_gb`) and unknown containers are refused with 400.

503.description: Object storage did not start the upload.

get.summary:
An asset with its jobs and a summary of its probe: poll this after completing the upload
(`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

post.summary:
The file is uploaded: finish the multipart upload, check the object and queue the probe
(`PUBLISH_MEDIA`). Repeating the call for an asset past the upload returns it unchanged.

400.description: The storage did not accept the parts, or the file is empty, over the limit or not the announced size.

put.summary:
Record which title or episode an asset is for and, once it is playable, link it in the
catalog as the video of that title or episode (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

409.description: The asset has no playable renditions yet.

put.summary:
Allow (or stop allowing) members with the download perk to fetch the original file
(`PUBLISH_MEDIA`). An asset with this on keeps its original on the hot tier.

409.description: The asset is the Live TV slate.

post.summary:
Probe the original again, for example after FFmpeg was installed on the server
(`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).
Queue the ladder transcode of an asset that waited for approval (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

get.summary: Every collection, drafts included (`MANAGE_COLLECTIONS`).

post.summary: Create a collection (`MANAGE_COLLECTIONS`).

get.summary: A collection with its titles in order, drafts included (`MANAGE_COLLECTIONS`).

put.summary: Replace the settings of a collection (`MANAGE_COLLECTIONS`).

delete.summary: Delete a collection (`MANAGE_COLLECTIONS`).

put.summary: Replace the titles of a collection, in display order (`MANAGE_COLLECTIONS`).
Hide a comment from every listing, or restore it. Hiding closes its open reports as `actioned`.
Replace the editable fields of an episode (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`). The asset link is untouched.

delete.summary: Delete an episode (`DELETE_CONTENT`). Deleting the last playable thing of a published title unpublishes it.

put.summary: Link or unlink the playable asset of an episode (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`). Unlinking unpublishes the episode.

get.summary: Skip windows of an episode, published or not (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

put.summary: Replace the skip windows of an episode (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

post.summary: Publish an episode (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`). An episode without an asset stays a draft (409).
Unpublish an episode (`PUBLISH_MEDIA` or `DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary: The report queue for reviews and comments, newest first, with an excerpt of the reported text.

post.summary: Close a report as `actioned` or `dismissed` (or reopen it with `open`).

put.summary: Hide a review from every listing, or restore it. Hiding closes its open reports as `actioned`.
Replace the editable fields of a season (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

delete.summary: Delete a season with its episodes (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

post.summary: Add an episode (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

get.summary: All titles, drafts included (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

parameters.name: published
parameters.description: `true` for published, `false` for drafts and unpublished titles.

post.summary: Create a draft title (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

get.summary: A title with everything under it, published or not (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

put.summary: Replace the editable fields of a title (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`). The asset link is untouched.

delete.summary: Delete a title with everything under it (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

post.summary:
Reserve an artwork object for a title and get a presigned `PUT` URL (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).
Upload the image with the same `Content-Type`, then save the returned `key` as the
title's `poster_key` / `backdrop_key` / `logo_key`, an episode's `still_key` or a
season's `poster_key`.

put.summary: Link or unlink the playable asset of a film (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).
Replace the skip windows of a title (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`): at most one of each kind, inside 24 hours.

post.summary:
Merge this title into another (`PUBLISH_MEDIA` and `DELETE_CONTENT`): seasons, episodes,
variants, trailers, markers and collection places move (the target wins a clash and fills
its gaps from this title); this title stays as a redirect.
Publish a title (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`). A title without a playable asset or a published episode stays a draft (409).
Add a season (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).
Add a trailer to a title (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).
Unpublish a title (`PUBLISH_MEDIA` or `DELETE_CONTENT`).
Add a variant (another cut) to a title (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

put.summary: Replace a trailer (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

delete.summary: Delete a trailer (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

put.summary: Replace a variant (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

delete.summary: Delete a variant (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

get.summary: The queue, active requests by due date first (`MANAGE_TAKEDOWNS`).

parameters.name: active_only
parameters.description: Only requests that still need staff (default true)

post.summary: Enter a request that arrived by email or form; the due date is computed now.

get.summary: One request (the read is logged).

post.summary: Refuse a request with a stated reason.
Extend the deadline by `days`, once, with a reason (GDPR article 12(3)).

Rectification of a Person link (MOD-DSR-007, spec section 6): correct which Person the requester's account is
linked to, with a logged reason. Needs `MANAGE_TAKEDOWNS` and `MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`; refused while a ban involves
either Person.

Restriction or objection (GDPR articles 18 and 21, MOD-DSR-006): hide the requester's shared activity (cinema,
library sharing, watching presence, recommendations) from discovery while the request is reviewed, or
show it again. Nothing is deleted. It also ends when the request is completed or declined. 409 when the request
is closed or already in that state.

Run a verified request. An export queues the self-service data package for the person (they
download it from Settings for 7 days); an erasure deletes the account through account
deletion and completes with an outcome that names the records that stay (D-124, G-66).
Record that staff checked who is asking; the reason says how.

get.summary: Staff: Activities waiting for review, oldest first, each with the bundle's hash and files.
Staff: the zip of a submitted bundle, as the owner uploaded it, to read before deciding.

post.summary:
Staff: approve (the proxy then serves that bundle once the application is released) or reject the
pending bundle.
Staff: switch an application off.
Staff: lift a suspension.

get.summary: Staff: versions waiting for review, oldest first, with their payload.

post.summary:
Staff: approve or reject a pending version, or revoke an approved one (it stops being served and every
enablement of it is removed).

get.summary: Staff: the zip of a version as the author uploaded it.
Staff: developer requests.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return rows older than this id.

post.summary: Staff: approve or reject a developer request.

get.summary: Staff: version queue.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return rows older than this id.

post.summary: Staff: approve, reject or send back a version.

get.summary: The directory queue for staff with `MANAGE_DIRECTORY`, oldest request first.

What a listing would look like in the directory, as its draft stands (`MANAGE_DIRECTORY`).
The card is the public shape plus `pending: true` while the request waits. The admin queue's
Preview opens the server page in preview mode (banner, no join). The category list is a
constant; hiding a category is the `directory.hidden_categories` platform setting.

patch.summary:
Decide a listing: approve or reject a request, take an approved listing down, and
feature approved ones (`MANAGE_DIRECTORY`). The decision is written to the platform access
log.

get.summary: The donation settings (prices, thresholds, perks, depths, expiry).

patch.summary:
Change settings with a JSON merge patch. The result is validated as a whole; nothing applies
on a failure. Takes effect immediately (no restart).

get.summary: Entitlement grants (from invoices, staff, or the legacy download table), newest first.

post.summary: Grant Patron time or a server pool contribution by hand.

delete.summary: Revoke a grant.

requestBody.description: The reason may also be sent as X-Audit-Log-Reason.

get.summary: Search invoices (newest first).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: An invoice id, an address, or a transaction id prefix.

parameters.name: needs_attention
parameters.description: Only underpaid, overpaid and late-paid invoices.

get.summary: One invoice with its payer, transactions and full audit trail. The read is access-logged.

post.summary:
Close an invoice by hand: `mark_paid` (credits the purpose once), `refund_noted` (the operator
refunded outside this system; a credit already given is reversed) or `dismiss`. The server
never moves funds.
Keep a donor or a server off the public leaderboards (or put them back).

get.summary:
The ranking with real names and amounts (staff view; the read is access-logged). Entries staff
hid are not listed.
The price sources and the current median.
Credited totals by purpose and by day, and invoice counts by state (default: this month).
Wallet health, watcher status, rate sources and invoice counts. Reveals no descriptor or key.

put.summary:
Set the active wallet from a watch-only descriptor. Descriptors with private keys are
refused. Older wallets stay watched for their open invoices. Returns the first addresses to
compare with the operator's own wallet.

post.summary: Derive the first receive addresses of a descriptor without saving anything.

put.summary:
Set one copy block (`MANAGE_ENTRANCE`, fresh second factor). Audited with the key and length.
The text is stored as written; the Entrance renders it with the restricted entrance profile of
the shared markdown renderer (no mentions, no custom emoji).

delete.summary: Remove an override, so the client's default shows again (`MANAGE_ENTRANCE`, fresh second factor).

put.summary:
Replace the Entrance hero image (`MANAGE_ENTRANCE`, fresh second factor). The image is sniffed
(never trusted by its declared type), shrunk, re-encoded without metadata and stored at
`entrance/hero`. Audited.

delete.summary: Remove the hero image, so the shipped art shows again (`MANAGE_ENTRANCE`, fresh second factor).

get.summary:
List the registered feature modules with their platform state (`MANAGE_FEATURES`).
The registry may be sparse: only registered features appear.

patch.summary: Enable, disable or configure a feature at the platform scope (`MANAGE_FEATURES`).

get.summary: Every server on the platform, by id (`MANAGE_GUILDS_GLOBAL`).
One server's metadata (`MANAGE_GUILDS_GLOBAL`).

delete.summary:
Delete a server (`MANAGE_GUILDS_GLOBAL`, reason required). Applied as the owner: the same soft
delete the owner gets, with the 30-day purge window and the usual `GUILD_DELETE`. The Staff
Server is refused.

post.summary:
Make another member the owner (`MANAGE_GUILDS_GLOBAL`, reason required). Applied as the
current owner, so the server hears the usual `GUILD_UPDATE`. The Staff Server is refused.

get.summary: The sources, newest last (`PUBLISH_READING`).

post.summary: Add a source (`PUBLISH_READING`). A local folder must be under an approved root.

delete.summary: Remove a source and its ledger. Drafts it already created stay (`PUBLISH_READING`).

patch.summary: Edit a source: label, on or off, polling, stability wait, owner (`PUBLISH_READING`).

post.summary:
Dry run: list the source and report the structure the importer detected (series, chapters,
files it cannot place, what is still settling). Writes nothing (`PUBLISH_READING`).

Scan now and import what is ready as draft submissions (`PUBLISH_READING`). A watched folder
also runs on its own schedule.

get.summary: List platform invites, newest first.

delete.summary: Revoke an open invite.

get.summary: List jobs, newest first (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

delete.summary: Delete a dead job (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

post.summary: Re-queue a dead job (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

put.summary: Change a chapter's number, title, volume or release group (`PUBLISH_READING`).

delete.summary: Delete a chapter and its pages (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary: Preview a chapter's page manifest, published or not (`PUBLISH_READING`).

put.summary:
Replace the whole page list of an image chapter: this is how pages are reordered,
replaced and removed (`PUBLISH_READING`). Object keys must live under
`library/{series_id}/{chapter_id}/`.

Replace one page of an image chapter with a new image (`PUBLISH_READING`). The image is converted like
an archive page (limits, dimensions, crop data, sized variants); the page keeps its position and
double-spread flag, and the page list changes key, so the offline cache and the CBZ export follow.

post.summary: Publish a chapter; it needs pages (`PUBLISH_READING`).
Unpublish a chapter (`PUBLISH_READING` or `DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary: The latest uploads of a chapter, newest first (`PUBLISH_READING`).

post.summary: Reserve an upload slot for a chapter's file and get the presigned `PUT` URL (`PUBLISH_READING`).
post.description:
The file's extension must fit the chapter's format (`.cbz .zip .cb7 .7z .cbr .rar` for
images, `.epub`, `.pdf`). Send the bytes to `upload_url` with `PUT`, then call the
`complete` endpoint. A slot that is never completed expires after a day.

409.description: The chapter already has an upload being converted, or uploads are not available.

get.summary: Open comment reports, oldest first (`REVIEW_READING`).

post.summary: Resolve a report: hide the comment or dismiss the report (`REVIEW_READING`).

put.summary: Change an edition (`PUBLISH_READING`).

delete.summary: Delete an edition and its chapters (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

post.summary: Add a draft chapter to an edition (`PUBLISH_READING`).
Add a volume to an edition (`PUBLISH_READING`).
Feature or unfeature a public reading list on the Library home (`PUBLISH_READING`).

get.summary: All series, drafts included (`PUBLISH_READING`).

parameters.name: genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated genres the series must have.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tags the series must have.

parameters.name: published
parameters.description: `true` for published, `false` for drafts and unpublished series.

post.summary: Create a draft series (`PUBLISH_READING`).

get.summary: A series with its editions, published or not (`PUBLISH_READING`).

put.summary: Replace the editable fields of a series (`PUBLISH_READING`).

delete.summary: Delete a series with everything under it (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary: Editions, volumes and every chapter of a series, published or not (`PUBLISH_READING`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 500. Without it every chapter is returned.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: `asc` (default) or `desc`: edition, then chapter number, then id.

post.summary: Add an edition (`PUBLISH_READING`).

Merge this series into another (`PUBLISH_READING` and `DELETE_CONTENT`): editions,
chapters, follows and progress move; this series stays as a redirect.
Publish a series (`PUBLISH_READING`).
Unpublish a series (`PUBLISH_READING` or `DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary:
Poll an upload: `awaiting_upload`, `queued`, `running`, `done`, `failed` or `expired`
(`PUBLISH_READING`).

delete.summary: Cancel an upload that was not completed and free its parts (`PUBLISH_READING`).

post.summary:
The file is uploaded: check it and queue the conversion (`PUBLISH_READING`). Repeating the call
for a queued or finished upload returns it unchanged.

400.description: The file is missing or over the size limit.

get.summary:
List the contents of an uploaded archive without converting it: pages per folder, ignored
files, `ComicInfo.xml` facts and why it would be refused (`PUBLISH_READING`). Available from
the moment the file is in storage until its conversion has run.

Resume a multipart upload: the parts that arrived and fresh URLs for the missing ones
(`PUBLISH_READING`).

409.description: Not a multipart upload, or no longer awaiting its file.

delete.summary: Delete a volume; its chapters stay, ungrouped (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary: `GET /admin/me`: the caller's platform permissions (any staff member).
A Person and its accounts (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`). The read is logged.

post.summary: Platform-ban a Person (`PLATFORM_BAN`).
Clear a Person's suspicion level (reason required).

Move a Discord identity to another account of the Person (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`, fresh second factor,
reason required, D-262). The target joins the Person in the same step when it is elsewhere. 409 when
the Person or either account is banned or suspended. The old row is kept as history; the old account
gets a system DM, and an email when its address is verified.

Put an account under this Person (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`, reason required). Refused (409) while
either Person is banned. A Person left without accounts is merged into this one.

put.summary: Replace a Person's staff notes (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).

get.summary: A Person's suspicion history, newest first (`MANAGE_INVITES`).

post.summary: Lift a Person's ban; accounts return while the cap allows (`PLATFORM_BAN`).

get.summary: DM and group DM channels an account takes part in (`READ_PRIVATE_CONTENT`; logged).

Read a conversation, including deleted messages younger than the retention window and
edit history (`READ_PRIVATE_CONTENT`). Reason and a fresh second factor required; the
request is logged before the content is returned.

parameters.name: channel_id
parameters.description: Channel snowflake (DM, group DM or server channel)

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only messages older than this id

get.summary: Channels of a server that `@everyone` cannot see (`READ_PRIVATE_CONTENT`; logged).
`GET /admin/reauth`: is the second-factor window open? (any staff member)

post.summary: `POST /admin/reauth`: prove a second factor to open the 15-minute window for this session.

get.summary:
The review queue: submitted and in review by default, for the kinds the caller may review
(`REVIEW_READING` for the Library kinds), never the caller's own submissions. Filters: kind,
state, `claimed=mine|unclaimed`, submitter, `min_age_hours`, title; sort and pagination.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Comma-separated states. Default: all for "my submissions", `submitted,in_review` for the queue.

parameters.name: min_age_hours
parameters.description: Queue only: only submissions waiting at least this many hours.

post.summary: Close a request without fulfilling it (reviewers of the section).

get.summary: A submission with items and the full timeline, internal notes included.

post.summary:
Approve: pending items are approved (rejected ones stay out) and the kind publishes. When
publishing fails the submission stays `approved` with a `publish_failed` note; call
`publish` to retry.
Claim a submission for 30 minutes (renews your own claim).

409.description: Not in the queue, or another reviewer holds the claim.

post.summary: A note on the timeline: public (the submitter sees it) or `internal`.

get.summary: The credits of a submission, revoked ones included (reviewers of the kind).

put.summary:
Resolve the duplicate panel: `merge` into an existing entry, mark as a `replacement`, or
`not_duplicate`. Needs the review claim. A merge or replacement earns no contribution credit.

get.summary: Possible duplicates with the reviewers' resolution (reviewers of the kind).

put.summary: Approve, reject (note required) or reset one item. Needs your live claim.

get.summary: Signed page URLs of a chapter under review (reviewers of the kind).

The review proxies of the videos in a submission (reviewers of the kind). Kinds without videos
answer an empty list.
The kind's preview (Library: series facts, editions and the chapters under review).

post.summary: Publish an approved submission (the retry after a failed publish).

Publish your own draft without review (the kind's publish permission, e.g.
`PUBLISH_READING`).
Reject; `reason` is required and visible to the submitter.
Give the claim back; the submission returns to the queue.
Send the submission back to the submitter; `reason` is required and visible to them.

Unpublishing for cause: withdraw the contribution credits of a submission (D-074). Needs
the kind's publish permission and a reason; the rows stay so the same item cannot earn a
second credit. Written to the staff access log.

get.summary: Every editable platform setting with its current value (`MANAGE_FEATURES`).

patch.summary: Change platform settings and limits without a restart (`MANAGE_FEATURES`).

get.summary: List staff (`APPOINT_STAFF`).

post.summary:
Appoint an account directly, without its acceptance (Owner only, behind re-auth; D-197 as amended
2026-10-15). Everyone else appoints through offers.

get.summary: Open delegations of appointment rights (`APPOINT_STAFF`).
Closed appointments and why each ended: `left`, `kicked` or `revoked` (`APPOINT_STAFF`).
Offers, newest first (`APPOINT_STAFF`).

post.summary:
Offer an appointment (`APPOINT_STAFF`). The appointee gets a system DM with Accept and
Decline and joins the staff only by accepting. Needs a fresh second factor.

delete.summary: Withdraw a pending offer (`APPOINT_STAFF`).

get.summary: Staff Server roles that can be assigned (`APPOINT_STAFF`).

delete.summary: Revoke an appointment (`APPOINT_STAFF`). The Owner cannot be revoked.

put.summary: Let a staff member appoint others within a ceiling (Owner only, D-132).

delete.summary: End a delegation (Owner only).

put.summary: Replace a staff member's roles (`APPOINT_STAFF`).

get.summary: Dashboard counts (`STAFF_BASIC`).
Persons with suspicion above zero, highest first.
System status: version, readiness probes, gateway sessions, queue depth (`OPERATOR`).

post.summary:
Send a test message to your own address through the configured mailer (`OPERATOR`, fresh second
factor). A 500 with code 900001 means the mailer refused; the log has the reason, the response does not.

get.summary: Jobs, newest first (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: A job id: only older jobs.

get.summary: One job with its log tail, encoder and warnings (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

post.summary:
Cancel a job (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`): a queued job stops at once, a running one when its worker
next reports.
Queue a failed or cancelled job again with a fresh attempt counter (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

get.summary: Queue depth: queued, running, and the last day's outcomes (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

post.summary:
Re-transcode one asset, a whole title or everything (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`): the ladder is
planned again from the stored probe and queued (a batch is capped at 500 assets; repeat for
the rest). The old files stay playable until the new ones are published.

Run the retention sweep now (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`): expired upload slots, originals and
proxies the retention policy lets go, unreferenced transcode prefixes, expired downloads. It
also runs hourly.

get.summary:
Worker tokens, newest first (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`). Only hashes are stored: the secret is shown
once, when the token is created.

post.summary:
Create a worker token (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`). The response carries the secret; it cannot be
shown again.

delete.summary:
Revoke a token (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`): it stops authenticating at once and the workers
registered with it are told to drain.

get.summary:
Workers that registered, with capabilities, last contact and the jobs they run
(`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

put.summary:
Tell a worker to finish its jobs and claim no more, or lift that (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`). The
worker learns it on its next heartbeat.

delete.summary: Remove one block from a schedule.

get.summary: All channels with their rules, disabled ones too.

post.summary: Create a channel (`MANAGE_TV`). A taken number is 409.

get.summary: A channel with its rules.

put.summary: Replace the editable fields of a channel.

delete.summary: Delete a channel with its schedule.

post.summary: Place a programme at a time; what it overlaps is trimmed, split or removed.

get.summary: The channel's recent imports, newest first.

post.summary:
Upload a guide (CSV or JSON text). The answer is the mapping report: each row matched, ambiguous (pick a
title), missing (will be skipped) or invalid. Nothing changes until it is confirmed.

get.summary: One import with its report.

community_enabled.description: Community is still on; a listing of a server that switched it off stays hidden.

Person of its own.

hide.description:
`true` hides the account's shared activity from discovery while the request is reviewed; `false` shows it
again.

reason.description: Why (required, kept in the access log).

delete_messages.description:

member's message self-delete is queued with servers and direct messages, no cut-off.

AdminTitleDetail.description: Everything about a title, unpublished parts included (staff).

AgeBand.description: How young the account was found to be (D-294).

confirmed_at.description:
When the account confirmed it was 18 or older (RFC 3339); `null` when it never did, said
"younger", or the answer was reset.

How age-restricted series are treated by a listing. Everyone sees them by

values.description: The chosen value of the Timeout select (seconds).

Discord's `allowed_mentions` object. `parse` may hold `users`, `roles` and
`everyone`; listed `users`/`roles` ids may ping even when their kind is not parsed.

A platform announcement: a banner every signed-in user sees, optionally also sent
as a DM from the system user.

ended_at_ms.description: Set when staff end it early.

send_dm.description: Whether the system user also DMs it to every active account.

critical.description:
Outage or security notice: cannot be dismissed and is always sent as a DM (D-192).

ends_at_ms.description: Stop showing at this time (default: never).

starts_at_ms.description: Start showing at this time (default: now).

Input of `PATCH /admin/announcements/{id}` (G-69): the text and the end of an announcement that
is still showing. Severity, `critical` and `send_dm` cannot change.

ends_at_ms.description: Stop showing at this time (must be in the future).

AppVersionAdmin.description: A version in the staff queue.

person_id.description: The Person the ban is on.

default_theme_by_section.description:
Section (`lounge`, `entrance`, `cinema`, `library`, `support`, `tv`) to shipped theme id. A

enabled.description: The module's new on/off state when the recipe set it.

settings.description: The setting keys the recipe set.

before.description: Slowmode the channel had before, in seconds.

role_ids.description: Staff Server role ids to start with.

first_pages.description: The first pages in reading order.

folders.description: Pages per folder, in reading order of their first page.

problems.description: Why this archive would be refused or needs attention; empty when it looks fine.

skipped.description: Files the importer ignores (junk, symlinks, unsupported files, nested archives).

url.description: Where the stored image is served from, when the store gave a URL.

ArtworkSlot.description: What an artwork upload is for; only names the object.

A reserved artwork object: `PUT` the image to `upload_url` with the same `Content-Type`,
then save `key` as `poster_key` / `backdrop_key` / `logo_key` / `still_key` / season `poster_key`.

AssertionCredential.description: The assertion a browser produced for `navigator.credentials.get`.

AssertionFields.description: Assertion response fields (all base64url, no padding).

Asset.description: One uploaded video and what became of it.

auto_ladder.description: The ladder is queued right after the probe instead of waiting for approval.

error.description: Why the asset is `failed`, in words for staff.

original_deleted.description: The original file is gone (retention deleted it); a re-transcode needs a new upload.

original_downloads.description: Members with the download perk may fetch the original.

playable.description: The ladder is ready to play (renditions exist).

asset_id.description:
The playable asset, or `null` to unlink it. Unlinking the last playable thing of a
published title unpublishes it.

oneOf.description: The probe, summarised for the editor.

blurhash.description: BlurHash placeholder to show until the image loads.

expires_at.description: Set when the attachment is a large file that will expire.

sr_filtered.description: The viewer's sensitive-media setting withheld the file: `url` is empty (D-230).

width.description: Pixel size, as declared by the uploader.

duration_secs.description: Voice messages: length in seconds (at most 120).

waveform.description: Voice messages: base64 waveform of up to 256 amplitude bytes.

The audit-log envelope. The lists SIDE ROOM does not populate yet are empty
arrays so Discord clients can parse the shape.

permissions.description: Decimal permission bitfield the bot would ask for.

url.description:
Send the browser here; the provider returns it to the callback, which ends in a redirect to
`/settings/user/connections?connected=<provider>` or `?error=<code>`.

already_installed.description: The bot was already in the guild (only for bot installs).

BackupsView.description: When the last backup, restore check and object snapshot happened (Unix ms; `None` when never), K-10.

BadgeObject.description:
A public profile badge: the catalogue id with English fallback text and an icon name
(G-53). Clients translate the ids they know and fall back to `description`.

delete_message_seconds.description: Seconds of message history to delete, 0 to 604800.

reason.description: Convenience; Discord carries the reason in `X-Audit-Log-Reason`.

Reason category of a platform ban (doc 06 section 5.4, doc 09). Only
`Serious` bans raise suspicion on the banned account's inviter (D-031).

BanDone.description: What a ban from a case did.

oneOf.description: Set when a serious ban raised suspicion on the inviter's Person.

BanReason.description:
Why the staff member bans (D-211). Each has a default [`BanCategory`] the ban dialog starts
from; staff can raise or lower it before confirming, and the stored category is what the
inviter suspicion rule reads (D-031).

ceremony_id.description: Send back with the finish call.

options.description:
`PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions` / `RequestOptions` JSON with base64url
binary fields; pass to `navigator.credentials.create/get({ publicKey })`
after decoding those fields.

visibility.description: `servers` (default) lets servers that run the module show it; `hidden` keeps it private.

year.description: Optional birth year (1900 to 2100); shared only as an age in announcements.

cents.description: Omitted when the donor hides the amount.

name.description: "Anonymous patron" when the donor hides the name.

BookmarkEntry.description: A bookmark and the message it points at, when the owner can still see it.

next_before.description: Pass back as `before` for the next page; absent at the end.

BotUserObject.description: The bot account of an application.

BuiltinTemplateObject.description: A template shipped with the server.

id.description:
Pass as `template` to `POST /guilds`, or as the path code of
`POST /guilds/templates/{code}`.

serialized_source_guild.description: The snapshot: `settings`, `roles` and `channels` with local ids.

delete_message_seconds.description: Seconds of message history to delete for every banned user, 0 to 604800.

failed_users.description: Users that could not be banned (hierarchy, owner, self or unknown).

BundleDetail.description: A bundle with the files it holds.

BundleState.description: Where a bundle is in review.

sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the uploaded zip: what staff approve.

recipients.description:
Users to ring or stop ringing; absent means everyone who is not connected (ring) or
everyone still ringing / yourself (stop).

token.description: The token from the "This wasn't me" link.

CardActionResult.description: Outcome of pressing a button on a staff card.

link.description: An app path to open next (the review page for a rejection that needs a reason).

reason_category.description: The why, from the section 8 vocabulary.

oneOf.description: Omit it to take the default of `reason_category` (D-211); staff can raise or lower it.

access.description: What this viewer may do: `read`, `work` or `manage`.

payload.description: The immutable snapshot taken at report time.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page.

moderators_may_see_name.description: Whether the reporter allowed server moderators to see their name.

oneOf.description: `None` when the viewer may not see who reported.

CaseSeverity.description: `standard` or `serious` (what drives the preset of a ban, D-211).

CaseSummary.description: One row of a case list.

active_holds.description: Holds on this case that are still in force.

escalated.description: Handed over from the server's moderators to platform staff.

oneOf.description: The takedown notice this case was opened for (D-334), when there is one.

target_channel_id.description: The channel a message case is about (the channel to mark age-restricted for misplaced adult content).

label_key.description: Web i18n key of the display name.

ChainReport.description: Result of verifying the whole chain.

first_bad_seq.description: First sequence number that failed verification.

head_hash.description: Hash of the newest verified row; record it elsewhere to detect truncation.

oneOf.description:
Second factor. Required when the account has two-factor authentication on,
unless this session passed a second-factor check in the last 15 minutes.

new_password.description: At least 10 characters and not easy to guess (zxcvbn score 3 or more).

Sign out every other session and trusted device (default `true`). Pass
`false` to keep the other browsers signed in.

ChannelFeatureObject.description: One module as a channel sees it.

guild_enabled.description: Whether the module is on in the server. A channel cannot switch it on by itself.

inherited.description:
What the channel would use with no overrides of its own: the defaults and the server's
settings, for the fields that belong to the channel level.

platform_disabled.description: The platform operator switched the module off everywhere.

schema.description: The settings schema of the channel level, for the auto-rendered form.

oneOf.description: The requesting user's membership of a thread.

message_count.description: Messages in a thread, capped at 50.

rtc_region.description: Voice and stage channels: always `null` (this installation has one voice region).

sr_watch_party_room.description: Voice channels: true for a Watch party room (D-208), a channel with a standing watch party.

total_message_sent.description: Every message ever sent in a thread.

video_quality_mode.description:

muted.description: `false` unmutes; `true` mutes for `mute_config` (default until turned off).

oneOf.description: The caller's progress (read / unread marks); absent when there is none.

source_key.description: Storage key of the original file (`pdf` / `epub` chapters).

A member credited for a film or for episodes of a title (CIN-SOC-003). Members who hide their
contributions, or were hidden by staff, are not listed.

CinemaFriendWatching.description: One friend who is watching something now.

CinemaHideContent.description: Body of a hide or restore.

reason.description: A note for the access log.

next_before.description: Pass back as `before` for the next page; absent at the end.

people.description: Matching cast, directors, writers and studios.

target_id.description: The title that stays; this one is merged into it.

is newer the write is not applied and the stored one is returned.

duration_secs.description: Length of the media, in seconds.

position_secs.description: Where the player is, in seconds.

applied.description:
`false`: the stored progress was newer than `base_updated_at_ms` and was left alone, so the
client should ask "continue where?" and may repeat the save with `force`.

progress.description: What is stored now (or, when paused, what was sent).

recorded.description: `false` when history is paused: the heartbeat was accepted but not stored.

known.description: People who share a server with the caller.

oneOf.description: `None` when the content no longer exists (deleted by its author or with its title).

next_before.description: Pass back as `before` for the next page; absent at the end.

episode_id.description: Comments only: the episode (`"0"` for the title or a movie).

excerpt.description: The first 400 characters of the text.

reason.description: A note for the access log.

rating.description: 1 to 10; also sets the caller's rating of the title.

ass_url.description: Signed ASS URL when the source was styled (the player may render it instead).

publish permission, e.g. `PUBLISH_READING`).

TvMediaKind.description: The catalog kind of a title as Live TV sees it.

offset_ms.description: How far into the current programme `at_ms` is.

TvPool.description: What may air in a daypart. Empty lists do not filter.

genres.description: A title must have every genre (lower case).

oneOf.description: Default: exclude, or include on an age-restricted channel.

tags.description: A title must have every tag (lower case).

TvReminder.description: One pending reminder of the caller, joined to the current guide (H-01).

lead_minutes.description: Minutes before the start the reminder fires.

remind_at.description: When the reminder fires, Unix milliseconds.

title.description:
The programme title now in the guide; `null` when the block is gone (the next tick drops the
reminder with a notice).

aired_ms.description: Time on air with media (programmes and bumpers) in the window.

TvRestricted.description: How a pool treats age-restricted titles.

grid_minutes.description: Programmes start on this grid in channel time (0: back to back).

no_repeat_window.description: Shuffle never repeats one of the last N picks (0 to 64).

TvSetNowInput.description: "On now": start a programme at once.

TvSlate.description: The off-air slate for staff (D-269): what is configured and whether it plays.

configured.description: A slate asset is configured (setting `tv.slate_asset`, or the `SR_TV_SLATE_ASSET` fallback).

duration_ms.description: Length of one pass of the loop, when known.

playable.description: The asset exists and has renditions to play.

TvSlot.description: A weekly slot as the API shows and accepts it.

id.description: Ignored on input.

weekday.description: 0 = Monday, in the channel time zone.

master_url.description: API path of the master playlist.

slate.description:
True when `master_url` is the instance slate loop played while the channel is off air (D-266):
`state` stays `off_air` and `current`, `offset_ms` stay null. False when the programme is live or
there is no slate (then there is no `master_url` either).

dropped.description: The chain source stopped showing it (replaced or reorged out).

accounts_left_deactivated.description: Accounts left deactivated because the account cap was reached.

account_id.description: The account found to be younger than allowed (decimal snowflake).

band.description:
`under_18`: reset and lock the age confirmation. `under_13` (below the minimum registration age): the same,
and the account is suspended.

note.description: Why (required, up to 500 characters; kept in the access log and, for a suspension, the audit reason).

erasure_request_id.description: The erasure request opened (or already open) for the account below the minimum age (D-341); nothing runs it.

inviter_notified.description: The inviter was told the invitee did not meet the entry rules (under 13).

member_notified.description: The account was told its age confirmation was reset (under 18, when a DM could be sent).

suspended.description: The account was suspended (under 13 and still active).

UnlinkResult.description: The Person created by an unlink.

UnreadCount.description: Unread published chapters of one followed series.

chapter_count.description: Number of the highest chapter published, for "sort by progress".

last_read_at_ms.description: Last time the member read something in this series.

UpcomingBirthday.description: A member's birthday as other members of a server see it (never the year).

UpdateItem.description: One entry of the latest-updates feed.

UpdateSubmission.description: Editable fields of an open submission.

next_before.description: Pass back as `before` for the next page; absent at the end.

notified.description: Uploaders or authors who got the system DM.

review_case_id.description: The review case opened because a Person reached the threshold.

Upload.description: An upload as the API shows it (the status the client polls).

error.description: Why the upload failed, naming the offending page or file.

metadata.description: Title, number, volume, writers and so on read from the file, for the editor to offer.

UploadAllowance.description: What a member has left of today's upload allowance (`None` limits for staff).

UploadKind.description: What an uploaded file is expected to be (from the chapter's format).

UploadParts.description: What a resuming client needs: which parts are in, and URLs for the rest.

missing.description: Fresh URLs for the parts still missing (or received with the wrong size).

auto_ladder.description: Queue the ladder right after the probe (default true for staff uploads).

filename.description: The file name on the member's disk; only its extension is used.

title_id.description: The catalog item the video is for. Linking it as the playable asset is a separate step.

parts.description:
One presigned `PUT` per part (a file no larger than `part_size` has one). Send each part
with `PUT` and keep the `ETag` response header.

UploadStatus.description: Where an upload is in its life.

UrlMapping.description: One URL mapping: requests to `<activity origin><prefix>/...` are fetched from `target`.

prefix.description: `/api`: a path of one or more segments, never `/`.

UserFeatureObject.description: One module as a person sees it.

schema.description: The settings schema of the personal level, for the auto-rendered form.

settings.description: The person's effective preferences (defaults plus what they chose).

message_notifications.description: 0 all messages, 1 only mentions, 2 nothing; `null` inherits the guild default.

avatar.description: Avatar hash (`/cdn/avatars/{id}/{hash}.png`), when one is set.

banner.description: Profile banner hash (`/cdn/avatars/{id}/{hash}.png`), when one is set.

oneOf.description: The server tag this user displays (LNG-SSET-012); Discord's `primary_guild`.

sr_patron.description:
Patron badge and ring show for this user (D-256): the Patron entitlement is active or in
grace and the badge is not hidden. Always present; never a third state.

avatar_decoration.description: Slug of the avatar decoration, if one is set.

profile_effect.description: Slug of the profile effect, if one is set.

theme_colors.description: The two profile theme colours (0xRRGGBB), primary first.

UserRef.description:
User object embedded in messages (author, mentions). Fields come from the user
lookup (open question 157); without a row only the id is known.

avatar_url.description: Webhook authors only (DEV-BOT-006): the per-message avatar, an image-proxy path.

oneOf.description: The server tag the author displays (LNG-SSET-012).

sr_patron.description:
Patron badge and ring show for this user (D-256): the Patron entitlement is active or in
grace and the badge is not hidden. Always present; never a third state.

version.description: Bumps on every save; 0 when nothing was ever saved.

code.description: 3 to 32 letters, digits or hyphens; `null` or an empty string releases the code.

VanityObject.description: The vanity URL of a server.

code.description: The code; `null` while the server has none.

public_key.description: Base64url, uncompressed P-256 point; pass it to `pushManager.subscribe`.

VerificationField.description: One field of the membership screening form (Discord's `form_fields`).

field_type.description: Always `TERMS`: the rules the member agrees to.

VersionConflictBody.description: The 409 body of a stale `expected_version`: the usual error object plus the current playback.

status.description: The new status, at most 500 characters. `null` or an empty string clears it.

Votes.description: Vote counts of a suggestion card.

addresses.description: The first addresses, to compare with the operator's own wallet.

fingerprint.description: First 8 hex characters of SHA-256 of the descriptor. The descriptor itself is never returned.

text.description: Up to 1000 characters; sent to the person as a system DM that never names a reporter.

WatchParty.description: A watch party, as returned by the API and carried by `WATCH_PARTY_UPDATE`.

invite_code.description: The secret of the share link. Only members see it (and only on private parties).

oneOf.description: What is playing; `null` for an empty watch party room (state idle, D-227).
What the viewing account may do (absent in gateway events, which go to everybody).

tv_channel_id.description: Switch to a Live TV channel.

expected_version.description:
The `version` the client last applied. A different current version answers 409 with the
current state; omit it for last-writer-wins.

WatchPartyControlMode.description:
Who may do something: the host alone, the host and members with `CONTROL_WATCH_PARTY` or the
host's explicit controllers, or everybody.

channel_id.description: A guild channel (text or voice) or DM to bind to. Without it the party is private (link only).

empty.description:
An empty watch party room (D-227): no media yet, the first member to join hosts and picks one. Only
a persistent party bound to a server channel can be empty; `title_id` and `tv_channel_id` stay unset.

title_id.description: The Cinema title. Omit it (or send "0") for a Live TV party and give `tv_channel_id` instead.

tv_channel_id.description: A Live TV channel to watch together (no seeking; everyone follows the live edge).

WatchPartyHeartbeat.description: Body of `POST /watch-parties/{id}/heartbeat`: the member's liveness, clock estimate and player state.

buffering.description: `true` when the player has been stalled (report once it passes ~1.5 s), `false` when it recovered.

rtt_ms.description: The member's round-trip estimate to the server.

WatchPartyHeartbeatResult.description: Answer of the heartbeat: the clock sample and the current playback (a fallback for a lost event).

member.description: `false`: the caller is no longer in the party (removed or ended).

invite_code.description: Required to join a private party.

asset_id.description:
The video asset; the viewer fetches HLS through `GET /cinema/assets/{asset_id}/playback`
(the normal play checks apply to each viewer).

WatchPartyMessageInput.description: Body of `POST /watch-parties/{id}/messages` (private parties' own chat; ephemeral).

buffering.description: Currently stalled (reported by the member's player).

is_controller.description: Granted by the host: may control playback when shared control is `controllers`.

WatchPartyPlayback.description:
Playback state as sent to clients (`WATCH_PARTY_PLAYBACK`, and inside the party object).

The media should be at `position_ms + (server_clock - at_ms) * rate` while `playing`; `expected_position_ms`
is that value at `server_time_ms` (the moment the server built this object). Clients correct their clock
offset (`server_time_ms - (client_now - rtt/2)`) and apply drift correction against it.

at_ms.description: Server clock at which `position_ms` was true.

auto_paused.description: Paused by the buffering rule ("Waiting for ..."), not by a controller.

server_time_ms.description: Server clock when this view was built (every state carries it, for the clock offset).

version.description: Strictly increasing; a client ignores any state older than the newest it applied.

emoji.description: A unicode emoji (or `name:id` of a custom one), up to 32 bytes.

auto_pause_buffering.description: Pause everybody when a participant buffers for more than 1.5 s.

max_wait_ms.description: Longest wait for a stalled participant before continuing without them.

persistent.description: A bound party that outlives its members (the Watch Party channel behaviour).

WatchPartyYou.description: The viewing account's standing in the party.

can_control.description: May play, pause, seek and change the speed now.

can_manage.description: May end the party, hand over the host role, kick.

WebhookMarker.description:
The webhook a message was posted through (D-235): staff views list the message under its
creator (`author_id`) with this marker, "via webhook <name>".

name.description: The name the message was posted under (the per-call override or the webhook name).

token.description: Only in the creation response; it cannot be recovered afterwards.

url.description: Execution path, only when the token is known.

channel_id.description: The channel the widget invites to.

libplacebo.description: ffmpeg was built with libplacebo (needed for Dolby Vision profile 5).

online.description: Heard from within the last minute.

session.name: sr_session
session.description: Browser session; non-GET requests also need `X-SR-CSRF`
